
```{r kinetic clustering}
# pick genes
goi_up = filter(tc_dea, treatment == "IL1B" & peak_sig == "up") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique() %>% sort()
goi_dn = filter(tc_dea, treatment == "IL1B" & peak_sig == "dn") %>% pull(Gene) %>% unique() %>% sort()

set.seed(777)
clust_up <- tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B" & Gene %in% goi_up) %>%
  select(Gene, time, log2fold) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "time", values_from = "log2fold") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  t() %>% scale() %>% t() %>%                          # z-score per gene across time
  kmeans(centers = 7, nstart = 7, iter.max = 100) %>%
  .$cluster %>%
  as.data.frame(nm = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(cluster = paste0("up_", cluster)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene")

set.seed(777)
clust_dn <- tc_dea %>%
  filter(treatment == "IL1B" & Gene %in% goi_dn) %>%
  select(Gene, time, log2fold) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "time", values_from = "log2fold") %>%
  column_to_rownames("Gene") %>%
  t() %>% scale() %>% t() %>%
  kmeans(centers = 4, nstart = 4, iter.max = 100) %>%
  .$cluster %>%
  as.data.frame(nm = "cluster") %>%
  mutate(cluster = paste0("dn_", cluster)) %>%
  rownames_to_column("Gene")

cluster_assignments = rbind(clust_up, clust_dn) %>% arrange(Gene)

df = tc_dea %>%
  left_join(cluster_assignments, by = "Gene") %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(cluster),
    treatment == "IL1B"
    ) %>%
  mutate(
    cluster = factor(
      cluster,
      levels = c(
        "up_4", "up_2", "up_1", "up_5", "up_6", "up_7", "up_3",
        "dn_4", "dn_3", "dn_1", "dn_2"
      )
    )
  )

ggplot(
  df,
  aes(x = time, y = log2fold)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~cluster) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = cluster),
    geom = "line", 
    fun = "mean"
    ) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")
```
